depiction.primary_object: two human upper-body silhouettes above a microphone
modifiers: diagonal slash through the entire icon
depiction.composition: compound glyph with two people in back, microphone in front, crossed out by diagonal line

readings.meaning: mute all participants / group voice chat disabled
no speaking in group / audience muted
cancel voice meeting or audio conference

ambiguity: At small sizes, the overlapping people, microphone, and diagonal slash clutter together and can look like a generic 'no group/users' icon or a broken symbol.
task_intents: turn off audience microphones by default

reasoning: The icon is a UI state toggle ('mute all participants' or 'group voice disabled') combining two people, a microphone, and a slash into a cramped glyph. At list-icon size the overlapping shapes become nearly illegible and are easily confused with 'remove users' or 'no group', and virtually no real-world to-do tasks have 'muting a group' as their central subject.
